cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Give It Up
cards.instruction: Persuade someone to surrender something they value.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let me catalogue your medal for the charity auction. We need its actual event and year, not just 'old medal.'

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It's the only thing I've ever won.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then provenance matters. I'll catalogue your name and result, not just the metal.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Could I lend it for display instead? I still want people to know I won.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: A loan isn't an auction lot. Present it to the buyer yourself; I'll introduce you as the winner.

reason: Shorten professional explanation into the actual catalogue entry and introduction; preserve B recognition as the reason to surrender the medal.
